title: Richard Hicks appointed as Aston Martin reserve driver
caption: Richard Hicks joins Aston Martin as reserve driver.
body:
Aston Martin has announced that Richard Hicks has joined the squad as a reserve driver. The update was released as a breaking announcement.

Richard Hicks is an Australian driver who competes under race number 24. He is currently under contract with Schubert Motorsport in the XGT series for 2024 and has not yet recorded a race result in the league.

Aston Martin competes in the F1 series and sits third in the 2024 constructors' standings with 121 points. The team’s current race drivers are Gunner Tai and Jacob Vavro, with junior drivers Gideon Lettink and Kaizer Navarro, and the team is led by principal Ethan Aston. So far the squad has achieved one win and two podiums in the 2024 season.
